title: NotificationPayload v1
description: Structured payload published to the classification SNS topic after triage. All triage fields are nullable in Phase 1 (set in later phases).

updateOf.description: SNS message ID of the previous notification for this event; null on first publish

affectedAccountCount.description: Total number of affected accounts at time of publish

urgency.description: Urgency tier computed by precision tool — populated from Phase 2.

deadline.description: ISO 8601 date of the earliest customer-impacting deadline.

deadline_basis.description: Quoted phrase from the event that gave the deadline.

precheck.description: Precheck name to run before finalising disposition, or null.

verificationSteps.description: Operator verification steps from the classifier.

impactSummary.description: Impact inventory result from build_impact_inventory — populated from Phase 3 for BREAKING_CHANGE, SECURITY_RELATED, and COST_IMPLICATION events. Null for other classes.

impact_status.description: in_scope_unverified added 2026-09-28 (working spec feat-devops-agent-enrichment req §1a): the event's listed resources are in scope, but confirmed impact depends on a client-side factor (trust store, TLS version, SDK version) AWS cannot see — schema-compatible addition, existing readers treating unknown enum values as unverifiable degrade safely.

enrichment.description: Whether an enrichment lookup/investigation ran for this inventory, and if not, why. Added 2026-09-28 (task 0b).

costProjection.description: Cost projection result from project_cost — populated from Phase 3 for COST_IMPLICATION events and BREAKING_CHANGE events carrying extended-support pricing. Null otherwise, or when unknown.

assignedTeam.description: Routing destination team — null until Phase 6.

impact.description: DevOps Agent investigation outcome (R12.7), or R8's default when the module is disabled or the event was not eligible for investigation.

investigationLink.description: Link to the AWS DevOps Agent investigation, populated only when impact != null and an investigation actually ran.

readinessFeasibility.description: DevOps Agent readiness assessment outcome (R12.3), null if not assessed or the readiness module is disabled for this Agent Space.

readinessBlockers.description: Blocking conditions from the readiness assessment, empty array when readinessFeasibility is 'ready'.

readinessRisk.description: Risk level of making the assessed change, per the readiness assessment.

readinessAssessmentLink.description: Link to the DevOps Agent readiness investigation, same URL format as investigationLink.
